prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey tool shed in a forest village built among giant trees (rustic log houses, carved wood, lanterns). thick golden-brown straw thatch roof walls of vertical weathered wooden planks. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 144 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached layout-guide image into ONE isolated forest-village tool shed sprite. Preserve the guide's precise 1008×896 canvas / 144×128 art-pixel proportions (7×7 source pixels per art pixel), rectangular roof silhouette x=14–994 y=196–490, straight horizontal roof/front split at y=490, and narrower front-wall silhouette x=56–952 y=490–896. Classic 3/4 top-down JRPG view: broad golden-brown thick straw-thatched roof seen from above, wall below viewed straight on, one story only. Replace magenta everywhere with TRUE TRANSPARENCY, including empty upper margin and side margins; no ground and no cast shadow. The roof surface is upper golden rectangular portion, featuring carefully organized overlapping straw bundles and an irregular chunky thatch eave at the split, maintaining the overall silhouette. Front wall made of individually legible vertical weathered wood planks, deep brown beams and carved timber trim, understated rustic tool-shed details. Make a genuine dark-brown walk-through door on the front wall reaching the bottom ground level, and small warm amber glowing multi-pane windows in their exact positions IF PRESENT IN GUIDE; preserve any existing outlined door or yellow-window rectangles precisely instead of moving or resizing them. Do not place windows or doors on roof. Add only tiny complementary eave and wooden bracket details. No objects outside sprite silhouette except perhaps a tiny chimney in the empty upper margin. Premium modern HD pixel-art JRPG sprite, uniformly aligned crisp square art pixels at exactly 7×7 display pixels, sharp hard edges, absolutely no antialiasing or smoothing, no blur, no soft brush, no gradients, no photographic textures, no random noise, no checkerboard dithering. Deliberately placed cohesive clusters 3–10 art pixels, 4–6 well-separated earthy shades per material, shadows hue-shifted saturated red-purple, highlights warm yellow; neutral soft even upper-left overcast evening, only windows emit amber light, no light pools, no night darkening, no vignette. No text, no people. Output transparent-background PNG-style pixel-art image.
